ModMetaData.name: RimPsychedelics
ModMetaData.author: Janowar
ModMetaData.description:
For the psychonauts of the Rim.
Adds a completely new drug effect mechanic to handle psychedelic class drugs. Allows for chained hediffs that build up to a peak, come back down, and have long resolution periods. A psychedelic trip may be good or bad, may inspire a pawn, may drive them insane, or permanently change the way they think.
Includes a framework for psychedelic class drugs, and 3 new non-addictive psychedelic drugs: LYS - Hard to produce, long acting major mood boosts. Fluff - Moderately difficult to produce, stong social interaction effects. day-after crash. Mindcap - Easy to produce, strong and short acting, highly variable.
New psychedelic class drugs can be added with XML only with a high degree of customization. Integrates with VSIE if installed.
Additional contributors: Art - NelsonArts Original LYS mod - Bhel Descriptions and Flavor - TigerLily
